stated_objective: Mandate good-faith mediation within 30+30 days and expand mediator certification to reduce court backlog.
Resolve small civil claims (<=Rp200M, raised to <=Rp500M in PERMA 4/2019) within 25 working days.
Provide integrated electronic case administration and e-Litigation across civil, religious, and TUN courts.
implementing_unit: Secretary of MA, Ditjen Badilum/Badilag/Badilmiltun, Court Chairs

stated_objective: Eliminate gender discrimination and ensure non-discriminatory judicial examination for women facing the law.
Enable electronic criminal administration and remote hearings, later expanded to integrated e-Berpadu in PERMA 8/2022.

Provide DIPA-funded court fee waivers (Prodeo), mobile hearings outside courtrooms (Sidang di Luar Gedung), and free legal aid posts (Posbakum) for indigent litigants, complemented by integrated civil-status mobile courts in PERMA 1/2015.
implementing_unit: PN, PA/Mahkamah Syar'iyah, PTUN, Ditjen Badilum, Ditjen Badilag

stated_objective: Provide uniform criminal procedural rules for investigating, prosecuting, trying, and executing penalties against corporations and/or their controlling managers.

Establish binding judicial guidelines for adjudicating civil, criminal, and administrative environmental cases, including strict liability criteria, scientific evidence, restoration, and Anti-SLAPP protection.
implementing_unit: PN, PTUN, PT, PTTUN, Mahkamah Agung RI

stated_objective: Provide civil procedural rules for representative group lawsuits (class actions) to realize simple, fast, and low-cost collective justice.
implementing_unit: Pengadilan Negeri (PN), Pengadilan Tinggi (PT), Mahkamah Agung RI

stated_objective: Establish binding trial-stage restorative justice guidelines prioritizing victim restoration, defendant accountability, conditional/supervision sentencing, and standardized Pasal 21 verdict citation.
implementing_unit: PN, PT, Mahkamah Agung RI, Ditjen Badilum

stated_objective: Guarantee reasonable accommodation, non-discrimination, initial/personal assessments, disaggregated Data Pilah, and mandatory annual M&E (Pasal 40) across all 6 judicial case types.
implementing_unit: MA RI, Ditjen Badilum, Badilag, Badilmiltun, PN/PA/PTUN/Dilmil

stated_objective: Confirm PTUN absolute jurisdiction over government factual actions and OOD disputes, set a 90-day filing window tolled by administrative remedies, and unify administrative-law/AUPB review.
implementing_unit: PTUN, PTTUN, PN, PT, Mahkamah Agung RI

stated_objective: Provide unified court objection procedures (Pemohon/Termohon Keberatan, 14-day filing, record-based review) for public information disputes in PN and PTUN.
implementing_unit: PTUN, PN, Mahkamah Agung RI, Komisi Informasi

stated_objective: Establish expedited 21-working-day PTUN and final-and-binding PTTUN procedures for assessing administrative abuse of authority after APIP oversight and before criminal proceedings.
Establish standardized court-stage diversion procedures (musyawarah diversi and penetapan) to resolve juvenile cases outside formal detention and criminal sentencing.
implementing_unit: Juvenile Judges (PN), Bapas, Social Workers, Prosecutors

stated_objective: Require exhaustion of administrative remedies prior to PTUN lawsuits (primum remedium) and standardize the 90-working-day filing deadline following administrative-remedy decisions.
Adjust the KUHP misdemeanor threshold from Rp250 to Rp2,500,000, mandate summary proceedings (acara pemeriksaan cepat / Pid.C), and prevent pre-trial detention for petty offenses.
